driver.text: Wall Street ended higher as the Fed held its key rate steady, as expected; the statement upgraded its view of the economy but said inflation remains elevated, and CME FedWatch showed an 85.0% chance of a 25 bp hike in December (78.3% a day earlier). The Philadelphia Semiconductor index rose 1.8%, its fourth straight gain, after SK Hynix reported a more than sevenfold jump in quarterly profit (Micron +5.9%). U.S. crude rose after Houthi attacks on a Saudi refinery. Vertiv +16.5% on a beat and raised guidance; Robinhood -3.3% on weaker crypto trading. After the close, Microsoft rose over 4% and Alphabet fell more than 7% in extended trading after results. Thursday brings the PCE inflation report and advance Q3 GDP. SOX closing level and 10Y yield not verified from an allowed source.
